After a $2.9M sellout, you have another chance to gain exposure

Hi Oleg,

Starcloud (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VWYnbB3Qm585N2kMHD8HS_K0VrHz2f5S1vMwN4vJDM23pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3mRN6bm1xBhYmKhW5466z-3TVqHyW6YgJRP1qV_mVW2wyybN68L7QcW2lSWmF5n7_NNW2nvXGZ7NkS0BW5ZbF-z62X4KdW5prWrL5rxFWhW8vJJlT3MfNwqW6lMKsq5tt4wPW5gG9gy72nvx2W3c431r57lgtVW2VqW61774H1vW2y58-64Hl5H_W8r8pZ25TCRggW47V2GL8CmnZ9W41pdBb8LcnLwN4Dg_DwW3V2QW2tRHnX5wkG3WW2mwDqV3ZqS_tW4l_KdT4KVF_RW2V2V2h3qKrybW15-tGy4vfMyHW1t3Bwc6QW1NVW6Djp189ltRcQW5_W_6l6-NyTJW5xrTQX2DvXCBN2YZL7Vzb_F-f4vz2hz04 ) CEO Philip Johnston recently told McKinsey that, “within the next decade, I expect most new compute capacity to be deployed in space.”¹

Why? Data centers on the ground are hitting hard limits on power, land, and cooling, just as demand for AI reaches new heights.¹

In orbit, the equation flips. Solar power is continuous and abundant, heat radiates away into the vacuum of space, and there are no zoning battles, grid queues, or water bills to fight through.¹

It's a bold thesis, but Starcloud has been backing it up by breaking new ground.

In collaboration with NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Starlink, the company was the first to train an AI model in space, run a version of Gemini, and execute high-powered inference on satellite imagery.²

Investors have noticed:

- One of the first (if not the first) to market with space-based data centers.³
- Est. $1.1B valuation, the fastest Y Combinator grad to pass $1B.⁴
- $193M+ raised to date from a16z, Google, Sequoia, and more.⁵
- Targeting a new $200M+ round that would double its valuation.⁴

There’s no guarantee that revenue, funding, or valuation will continue to grow for Starcloud, or that the company will be profitable. See the risk disclosures on the offering page.

Our first Starcloud offering sold out with $2.9 million in commitments.

Now, with Series Starcloud-QP-2 (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VWYnbB3Qm585N2kMHD8HS_K0VrHz2f5S1vMwN4vJDM23pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3mRN6bm1xBhYmKhW5466z-3TVqHyW6YgJRP1qV_mVW2wyybN68L7QcW2lSWmF5n7_NNW2nvXGZ7NkS0BW5ZbF-z62X4KdW5prWrL5rxFWhW8vJJlT3MfNwqW6lMKsq5tt4wPW5gG9gy72nvx2W3c431r57lgtVW2VqW61774H1vW2y58-64Hl5H_W8r8pZ25TCRggW47V2GL8CmnZ9W41pdBb8LcnLwN4Dg_DwW3V2QW2tRHnX5wkG3WW2mwDqV3ZqS_tW4l_KdT4KVF_RW2V2V2h3qKrybW15-tGy4vfMyHW1t3Bwc6QW1NVW6Djp189ltRcQW5_W_6l6-NyTJW5xrTQX2DvXCBN2YZL7Vzb_F-f4vz2hz04 ) , qualified purchasers have another

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk-off dominates. A stalled CLARITY Act, an 11% Kospi collapse and a looming Fed decision knocked Bitcoin toward $63K, while exchange shutdowns and an oracle failure exposed the market's thinning plumbing. 🏛️ US Senate Shelves the CLARITY Act, Pushing Crypto's Big Bill Toward September Majority Leader John Thune moved federal nominations and a Russia sanctions package ahead of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, and Senator Lindsey Graham's memorial services consumed floor time Tuesday and Wednesday. With Senate rules generally allowing one contested bill at a time and recess beginning August 8, the industry's central legislative effort has days rather than weeks of runway. Polymarket odds of 2026 passage collapsed to roughly 37%. Read full story 📉 Bitcoin Slides Toward $63K as South Korea Craters and Traders Brace for the Fed Bitcoin shed roughly 2.5% to a 10-day low near $63,200 and Ethereum fell over 3% to about $1,880, with more than $600M liquidated in 24 hours. South Korea's Kospi plunged 11% on a semiconductor rout, spilling into digital assets. The CME FedWatch tool now prices a 35.8% chance of a rate hike at Wednesday's FOMC decision, up from 25.7% a week ago. More details ⚡ Oracle Failure on Hyperliquid Wipes Out $57M in SK Hynix Perp Longs An anomalous pre-market print on South Korea's NXT venue valued one SK Hynix share at 1,272,000 won — roughly 30% below the prior close — and the xyz:SKHYNIX perpetual's oracle took it as reference. The contract fell 17.9%, liquidating about $57.4M across 960 long accounts. The market was deployed by Trade.xyz under HIP-3, not by Hyperliquid itself, and cross-margin design widened the damage. Read more 🏚️ BitMEX and BitMart May Be the First Casualties of the Trading Slump Centralized exchange volumes have fallen to $1.05 trillion, the quietest stretch in over two years, and the mid-tier is buckling. BitMEX — inventor of the perpetual swap — announced a September shutdown, BitMart began winding down after nine years with trading ending August 26, and AscendEX halted operations earlier this month. Analysts point to vanished retail flow, compressed fees and rising compliance costs. Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Hi all, happy Tuesday! Today we break down the risk-off move in global markets, including the unusual move lower across both oil and risk assets. In addition to this, we discuss HYPE’s underperformance despite positive developments surrounding the CXMT IPO in China.

Let’s get into it.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC closed Monday down -2.4% amid a broader contraction following increased geopolitical and macro uncertainty. Equities, gold, and oil all ended the day in the red, an unusual alignment across these asset classes.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/09635de4-c489-4bfe-9997-49f4995d981e/image.png?t=1785241732)
Caption: 

This underperformance comes against the backdrop of tomorrow’s FOMC meeting. After falling sharply following a cooler-than-expected CPI print two weeks ago, rate-hike odds on CME FedWatch have climbed back to just under 40%. Selling accelerated after Monday's close, when Bloomberg reported that [Citadel Securities sees a surprise hike as a live possibility](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-27/citadel-securities-sees-warsh-delivering-surprise-fed-rate-hike).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/fa1dbc0e-d30c-4a39-b0aa-d4380567af49/image.png?t=1785241731)
Caption: 

In terms of sectors, the only indices to outperform on Monday were the 2025 Crypto Equities cohort (+1.6%), the Solana Ecosystem index (+1.5%), and the Launchpad index (+0.4%). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3c5be9cc-7ee6-4e33-acb1-4bfcd9270060/image.png?t=1785241732)
Caption: 

The Perps index (-6.1%) was among the worst-performing indices on Monday, driven by a sharp decline in HYPE. While exchange metrics, covered below by Carlos, remain positive, HYPE has been pressured by a series of large unstaking requests and concerns around regulation. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ccfa08c1-4a50-4137-b73e-362cb368c5fd/image.png?t=1785241734)
Caption:
